summary: Innovative Food Holdings filed an 8-K on September 18, 2026, reporting a September 14 material agreement. The company amended employment agreements with Argie Liarakos and Gary Schubert, converting 150,000 and 1,350,000 performance-based restricted shares, respectively, into time-based awards that accelerate on a change of control, termination without cause, or good-reason resignation. It also appointed Erik Saterbo as CFO effective immediately. The board did not provide a recommendation. The equity conversion removes performance hurdles and creates potential change-of-control overhang; monitor share dilution and any strategic process.
